# Operations: Printed circuit boards

Run with `./ise commit <operation> '<json parameters>'`, the MCP tool `ise_commit`, or `./ise run steps.json` for several at once (one undo step). 106 operations.

### `pcb.align`

line items up: "left", "right", "top", "bottom", "center_x"
(one vertical centre line) or "center_y"; to the `reference` item's edge
or centre when given, else to the outermost of them (their mean for centres).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reference` | StableId |  |  |
| `targets` | StableId[] | yes |  |
| `to` | string | yes |  |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>

### `pcb.autoroute`

route the board's unrouted nets (or the ones named).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `board` | StableId | yes | Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine. |
| `grid` | number |  | Grid pitch (mm), default 0.25; finer finds more room, slower. |
| `layers` | string[] |  | Layers to use (default all). |
| `nets` | string[] |  | Nets to route; all unrouted nets when left out. |
| `pairs` | boolean |  | Route differential pairs together first, where they fit (default true). |
| `replace` | boolean |  | Remove earlier autorouted copper of these nets first (default true); dragged tracks (`reroute`) of these nets that now break a rule go too. |
| `rip_up` | boolean |  | Rip up and reroute nets in the way of one that cannot finish (default true). |
| `skip` | string[] |  | Nets to leave alone (a ground left to a pour). |
| `via_cost` | number |  | What a via costs, in millimetres of track (default 5). |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>

### `pcb.channel.repeat`

copy the placement (and routing) of the `source`
channel onto each of `channels`. Each channel's anchor (the component
matched to the first source reference) stays where it is and sets the
channel's angle, unless `step` [dx, dy] places channel k at the source
plus (k+1)·step. `routing` copies tracks and vias lying within the source
channel (replacing the target channel's on the mapped nets); `areas` adds a
placement rule area round every channel.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `areas` | boolean |  |  |
| `board` | StableId | yes | Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine. |
| `channels` | Channel[] | yes |  |
| `routing` | boolean |  |  |
| `source` | string[] | yes |  |
| `step` | number[] |  |  |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **Channel**: string[] \| object. One channel to repeat onto: its components, matched to the source's by footprint (then value) in reference order, or an explicit map source → target.
- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>

### `pcb.fanout`

a short 45° stub and a via from each of a part's SMD pads,
outward, where they keep every clearance — for pads reached on other layers
(a pour's net, a fine-pitch part). `nets` limits it; pads already joined to
copper are left alone.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |

| `component` | StableId | yes | Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine. |
| `length` | number |  | Longest stub (mm), default 2. |
| `nets` | string[] |  |  |
| `skip` | string[] |  |  |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>

### `pcb.footprint.define`

a footprint for this board (a part the library lacks), from its datasheet.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `board` | StableId | yes | Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine. |
| `footprint` | Footprint | yes |  |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **BodyPart** (One block of the package body, for the 3D board and height checks.): `at`: number[], `material`: string, `shape`?: BodyShape, `size`: number[], `z`: number[]
- **BodyShape**: `"box"`, `"cylinder"`
- **Chamfer** (Corners cut off a rectangular pad at 45°.): `corners`: string[], `ratio`: number
- **Footprint**: `body`?: BodyPart[], `courtyard`?: number[], `description`?: string, `kind`?: string, `name`: string, `pads`: Pad[], `silk`?: number[][][], `source`?: string
- **Pad**: `at`: number[], `chamfer`?: Chamfer, `corner`?: number, `drill`?: number[], `drill_offset`?: number[], `kind`?: PadKind, `no_paste`?: boolean, `number`: string, `paste`?: number[][], `polygon`?: number[][], `rotation`?: number, `shape`?: PadShape, `size`: number[], `stack`?: PadStack, `thermal_gap`?: number, `thermal_spoke`?: number, `trapezoid`?: number[], `zone_connection`?: PadConnection
- **PadConnection**: `"thermal"` (Four spokes across a gap: solders well, the pour does not sink the heat.), `"thermal_tht"` (Thermal reliefs on through-hole pads, SMD pads joined solid.), `"solid"` (Joined solid (best current and heat transfer, hardest to solder by hand).), `"none"` (Not joined: the pour keeps clear of the net's pads (they need tracks).)
- **PadKind**: `"smd"` (Surface-mount: copper, mask opening and paste on the component's side.), `"tht"` (Plated through-hole: copper on every layer, mask on both sides.), `"npth"` (A bare hole, no copper.)
- **PadShape**: "rect" \| "circle" \| "round_rect" \| "oval" \| "custom"
- **PadStack** (A through-hole pad's copper per layer: the pad itself on the component's side, `inner` on inner layers, `opposite` on the far side. `remove_inner` leaves no copper on inner layers (only the plated barrel).): `inner`?: StackLayer, `opposite`?: StackLayer, `remove_inner`?: boolean
- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.
- **StackLayer** (One copper layer group's pad in a pad stack.): `corner`?: number, `shape`?: PadShape, `size`: number[]

</details>

### `pcb.import`

a board and/or schematic from another EDA tool's file (KiCad, Eagle, EasyEDA
Standard and Pro, Altium, CADSTAR, Fabmaster, PADS, gEDA), told apart by content.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | number[] |  | Where the 3D board sits in the project (mm). |

### `pcb.route.pair`

route a differential pair's two tracks together, pad
pair to pad pair (`from`/`to`: the positive pad then the negative; found
when each net has two pads), through `steps`, keeping the gap; coupled
vias where a step changes layer; widths and gap from the net class's
impedance targets per layer unless given.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `angle` | Angle |  |  |
| `arc_radius` | number |  |  |
| `board` | StableId | yes | Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine. |
| `corners` | Corners |  |  |
| `from` | string[] |  |  |
| `gap` | number |  |  |
| `layer` | string |  | Starting layer (an SMD pad's own otherwise, else top). |
| `mode` | Mode |  |  |
| `optimize` | boolean |  |  |
| `pair` | string | yes | The pair by name, or either of its nets. |
| `steps` | PairStep[] |  |  |
| `to` | string[] |  |  |
| `via_pitch` | number |  | Centre-to-centre of the coupled vias. |
| `width` | number |  |  |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **Angle**: `"45"`, `"90"`, `"free"`. Line angles: 45° (default), 90° or free.
- **Corners**: `"sharp"` (Sharp 45° (or 90°) corners.), `"arc"` (Corners rounded into arcs (radius `arc_radius`, default 3 × the width).)
- **Mode**: `"walkaround"` (Go round obstacles.), `"shove"` (Push tracks and vias aside (round pads), walking round when they cannot move.), `"highlight"` (Go where put; report collisions.)
- **PairStep** (A point the pair's centreline goes through; a new layer there puts coupled vias.): `at`: number[], `layer`?: string
- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **BodyPart** (One block of the package body, for the 3D board and height checks.): `at`: number[], `material`: string, `shape`?: BodyShape, `size`: number[], `z`: number[]
- **BodyShape**: `"box"`, `"cylinder"`
- **Chamfer** (Corners cut off a rectangular pad at 45°.): `corners`: string[], `ratio`: number
- **Dir**: `"left"`, `"right"`, `"up"`, `"down"`. Which way a pin leaves the body (and so which way a wire leaves it).
- **Fill**: "none" \| "outline" \| "body". How a closed shape is filled.
- **Footprint**: `body`?: BodyPart[], `courtyard`?: number[], `description`?: string, `kind`?: string, `name`: string, `pads`: Pad[], `silk`?: number[][][], `source`?: string
- **Gfx**: object \| object \| object \| object \| object \| object. Drawing of a symbol body (symbol coordinates).
- **Pad**: `at`: number[], `chamfer`?: Chamfer, `corner`?: number, `drill`?: number[], `drill_offset`?: number[], `kind`?: PadKind, `no_paste`?: boolean, `number`: string, `paste`?: number[][], `polygon`?: number[][], `rotation`?: number, `shape`?: PadShape, `size`: number[], `stack`?: PadStack, `thermal_gap`?: number, `thermal_spoke`?: number, `trapezoid`?: number[], `zone_connection`?: PadConnection
- **PadConnection**: `"thermal"` (Four spokes across a gap: solders well, the pour does not sink the heat.), `"thermal_tht"` (Thermal reliefs on through-hole pads, SMD pads joined solid.), `"solid"` (Joined solid (best current and heat transfer, hardest to solder by hand).), `"none"` (Not joined: the pour keeps clear of the net's pads (they need tracks).)
- **PadKind**: `"smd"` (Surface-mount: copper, mask opening and paste on the component's side.), `"tht"` (Plated through-hole: copper on every layer, mask on both sides.), `"npth"` (A bare hole, no copper.)
- **PadShape**: "rect" \| "circle" \| "round_rect" \| "oval" \| "custom"
- **PadStack** (A through-hole pad's copper per layer: the pad itself on the component's side, `inner` on inner layers, `opposite` on the far side. `remove_inner` leaves no copper on inner layers (only the plated barrel).): `inner`?: StackLayer, `opposite`?: StackLayer, `remove_inner`?: boolean
- **PinDef**: `at`: number[], `etype`?: PinType, `hidden`?: boolean, `length`?: number, `name`?: string, `number`: string, `pads`?: string[], `shape`?: PinShape, `side`: Dir, `unit`?: integer
- **PinShape**: "line" \| "inverted_clock" \| "clock_low" \| "inverted" \| "clock" \| "input_low" \| "output_low" \| "edge_clock_high" \| "non_logic". How a pin is drawn where it meets the body (IEEE 91 / KiCad's graphic styles).
- **PinSpec** (One entry of a pin table for a box symbol (`ic`).): `hidden`?: boolean, `name`?: string, `number`?: string, `pads`?: string[], `side`?: Dir, `type`?: PinType
- **PinType**: `"input"`, `"output"`, `"bidirectional"`, `"tri_state"`, `"passive"`, `"power_in"`, `"power_out"`, `"open_collector"`, `"open_emitter"`, `"no_connect"`, `"unspecified"`. Electrical type of a pin, for the electrical-rules check.
- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.
- **StackLayer** (One copper layer group's pad in a pad stack.): `corner`?: number, `shape`?: PadShape, `size`: number[]
- **SymbolDef** (A library symbol.): `body_style`?: integer, `category`: string, `demorgan`?: Gfx[][], `demorgan_pins`?: object, `description`: string, `fields`?: object, `footprint`?: string, `footprints`?: string[], `keywords`?: string[], `lcsc`?: string, `manufacturer`?: string, `mpn`?: string, `name`: string, `pins`: PinDef[], `prefix`: string, `show_pin_names`?: boolean, `show_pin_numbers`?: boolean, `units`: Gfx[][], `value`?: string, `virtual_part`?: boolean

</details>

### `pcb.tune`

length-tune a net, a differential pair (both tracks meandered
together, then the skew taken out) or every member of a length group, to
`target` (for a group, its target or its longest member; for a pair in
skew mode, its longer track). Meanders go on the net's straight segments
(or only `track`/`segment`), trombone or sawtooth, round, chamfered or
square corners, at most `amplitude` high, legs `spacing` apart.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `amplitude` | number |  | Highest meander (mm); default 2 (3 for a pair). |
| `board` | StableId | yes | Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine. |
| `corner` | Corner |  |  |
| `group` | string |  |  |
| `mode` | TuneMode |  |  |
| `net` | string |  |  |
| `pair` | string |  |  |
| `radius` | number |  | Corner radius or chamfer (mm); default half the spacing. |
| `segment` | integer |  |  |
| `side` | SideSel |  |  |
| `spacing` | number |  | Leg pitch (mm); default 3 track widths (a pair: its pitch plus 3 widths). |
| `style` | Style |  |  |
| `target` | number |  |  |
| `tolerance` | number |  | Close enough (mm), default 0.01. |
| `track` | StableId |  | Only meander this track (and its segment `segment`). |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **Corner**: "round" \| "square" \| "chamfer"
- **SideSel**: "left" \| "right" \| "auto"
- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.
- **Style**: `"trombone"` (U-shaped legs (the usual meander).), `"sawtooth"` (A zigzag.)
- **TuneMode**: `"length"` (Bring the net (or pair, or group) to its length.), `"skew"` (Even out a pair's two tracks: meander the shorter one.)

</details>

### `pcb.via.fence`

a row of vias of `net` (usually ground) beside a track on
each side — a via fence that shields an RF or fast line. Along `track` (or a
path of `points`) every `pitch` mm at `offset` from its centre line.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `board` | StableId | yes | Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine. |

| `drill` | number |  |  |
| `group` | string |  |  |
| `net` | string | yes |  |
| `offset` | number |  | From the centre line (mm); default half the track width + clearance + the via radius. |
| `pitch` | number |  | Along the path (mm), default 1.5. |
| `points` | number[][] |  |  |
| `sides` | string |  | "both" (default), "left" or "right" (seen walking from the first point). |

### `pcb.via.stitch`

fill an area with a grid of vias of `net` (ground
stitching between pours): inside a zone's poured copper (`zone`), or an
`outline` on the board, every `pitch` mm, wherever a via keeps clear of
other copper, holes, the edge and keepouts. The vias form a group, laid
again (replacing the old ones) when stitched again; `exclude` points keep
a via out of a spot.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `board` | StableId | yes | Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine. |
| `diameter` | number |  |  |
| `drill` | number |  |  |
| `exclude` | number[][] |  | Spots to leave empty (a via within 1 pitch/2 of one is not placed). |
| `group` | string |  | Group name (default "stitch:<net>"); vias already in it are replaced. |
| `net` | string |  |  |
| `outline` | number[][] |  |  |
| `pitch` | number |  | Grid pitch (mm), default 2.5. |
| `stagger` | boolean |  | Offset every other row by half a pitch. |
| `zone` | StableId |  |  |

<details><summary>Types</summary>

- **StableId**: string. Identity of a design object. Survives save, reload, collaboration and rebuilds; ECS entity handles do not, so they never leave the engine.

</details>

</details>
